==Overview==
This One-Handed Mace ZvZ PvP build focuses on providing utility to your zerg while being hard to kill, as well as aiding in the clumping of enemies with {{Skill|Air Compressor}}. Variations of this build are frequently used by shotcallers when leading a zerg, as it offers ample survivability along with valuable defensive skills like {{Skill|Force Shield}} and {{Skill|Displacement Immunity}}.

==Usage==
==={{Item|Elder's Mace|45}}===
{{Skill|Sacred Ground}} —  Very effective when placed in chokepoints due to the silence and slow it provides. Additionally, positioning it beneath enemies using channeled abilities will interrupt them, making it doubly useful.

{{Skill|Snare Charge}} — A great skill for catching and slowing enemies, as the root can enable you or your allies to follow up with additional CC or damage. {{Skill|Air Compressor}} is an excellent choice when you can catch an enemy zerg without CC resistance, but you need to time it carefully to make it effective.

{{Skill|Deep Leap}} — Target enemy clumps or occasionally use it as just a stun on priority targets. If you're in a pinch and won't be able to use it to assist your zerg, it can serve as an escape movement skill.

{{Skill|Energetic}} — Great for sustaining your mana, but once you're familiar with the build and confident you won't need the mana regeneration, you can switch to {{Skill|Stunning Strike}}.


==={{Item|Elder's Judicator Armor|45}}===
{{Skill|Force Shield}} — An amazing skill for saving the zerg or tanks that get caught. Demon armor with {{Skill|Protection of the Fiends}} is invaluable if used well, but it can lead to more deaths if an ally isn't also using {{Skill|Protection of the Fiends}} simultaneously to provide you with the extra resistance. If your zerg has a few Judicator armors, you should opt for using demon armor instead.

{{Skill|Toughness}} — Straight up increases your defenses. Always good on any tank build.

{{Skill|Protective Instinct}} — The best option, and it can also be used occasionally to draw aggro from mobs, preventing them from attacking healers or other allies.
	
==={{Item|Elder's Knight Helmet|45}}===
{{Skill|Displacement Immunity}} — You'll usually use this skill when engaging enemies to avoid getting interrupted, but remember you can also use it to support allies. {{Skill|Electric Discharge}} from the Judicator Helm is also a good alternative option but currently not used often with this build.

{{Skill|Toughness}} — The standard choice for this build. Some people opt for {{Skill|Tenacity}}, but prioritizing your defensive stats is usually more important.


==={{Item|Elder's Cleric Sandals|45}}===
{{Skill|Blink}} — A good movement skill to readjust and help with landing good {{Skill|Air Compressor}} clumps.

{{Skill|Aggression}} — The standard choice for this build but you can also use {{Skill|Efficiency}} Remember that you can always switch to {{Skill|Courier}} if needed.


==={{Item|Elder's Martlock Cape|45}}===
{{Skill|Shield of Protection}} — Used in most tank builds, it can sometimes save you when caught in clumps. It activates automatically, like most capes, making it easy to benefit from.


==Rotations==
{{Rotation|Engage|Blink, Snare Charge, Deep Leap }}
* Tanks typically use skills situationally rather than following a strict rotation. Use {{Skill|Blink}} to reposition yourself, and {{Skill|Snare Charge}} to root enemies, allowing your zerg to catch up and group enemies together. As a follow-up or to catch even more enemies, you can also utilize {{Skill|Deep Leap}}.
{{Rotation|Engage 2|Blink, Air Compressor }}
* Switch to {{Skill|Air Compressor}} on your weapon. Use {{Skill|Blink}} to help you get into a good position, and use {{Skill|Air Compressor}} when the enemy's CC resistance isn't active. Keep an eye out for when the enemy zerg uses {{Skill|Displacement Immunity}}, and use your {{Skill|Air Compressor}} when it's on cooldown.


==Consumables==
{{Item|Major Resistance Potion}} — Use it when you get targeted or get caught in a clump. Otherwise you just use it as a general defensive cooldown but you are tough enough to save it for when you really need it.

{{Item|Avalonian Pork Omelette}} — The buff to your defensive stats helps all tank builds and the cooldown reduction is always great to have. You could use a {{Item|Pork Omelette}} but it is not recommended.
